// diagnostic

E0113

This value is String (text), but `name` returns Int

What

This value is String (text), but `name` returns Int

Why

A written return type is the function's contract, so the value it hands back must have that type

Fix

Convert or reshape the value into the declared type (for example `/%` for whole-number division, `[value]` for a list, `"{value}"` for text); the declared return type stays as written

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0113: tests/ui/callback_return_expected_row.stderr.

Error [E0113]: This value is String (text), but `line_starts` returns [Int]
  --> tests/ui/callback_return_expected_row.jet:9:16
    |
  9 |         return "built"
    |                ^^^^^^^
 Why: `line_starts` declares [Int] as its result, so the value it hands back must be [Int]
 Fix: Hand back a [Int] value: convert this value to [Int], or return the value you meant
